Non-Surgical Chest Contouring
The Gynaecomastia Treatment
Gynaecomastia treatment at ISAAC Luxe addresses the appearance of a female-like chest in men — from puffy nipples to fuller breast development — using non-surgical fat-reduction and skin-tightening technologies tailored to your specific grade of severity.

Gynaecomastia is most commonly caused by an imbalance between the hormones estrogen and testosterone, often influenced by factors like obesity, poor nutrition, or hormonal conditions. ISAAC Luxe assesses your condition across four grades — from puffy nipples alone to fully developed breast tissue — to recommend the right non-surgical approach.

Treatment Technologies

CoolTech

Freezes fat tissue (3°C to -8°C) while preserving collagen and skin elasticity. Non-invasive and painless — fat cells are eliminated naturally through the lymphatic system.

Exilis Elite

Monopolar radiofrequency combined with ultrasonic energy to target localised fat deposits and stimulate collagen, with results building progressively over following months.

What It Treats
Puffy Nipples Excess Chest Fat Excess Skin Hormonal Chest Development

What to Expect
Your Treatment Journey
01

Consultation

Your practitioner assesses your grade of gynaecomastia to recommend CoolTech, Exilis Elite, or a combination approach.

02

The Procedure

Depending on your plan, CoolTech targets fat cells for natural removal via the lymphatic system, or Exilis Elite stimulates collagen in the localised area.

03

Aftercare

Your practitioner will guide any post-session care specific to your chosen technology.

04

Results Timeline

CoolTech results develop progressively as fat cells are naturally processed by the body; Exilis Elite results build over the following months as collagen remodels the treated area.

The Visionary Behind ISAAC Luxe
Dr. Geetika Mittal Gupta
Founder and Medical Director of ISAAC Luxe / Aesthetic Physician, and award-winning cosmetologist — Dr. Geetika Mittal Gupta is one of India's most sought-after skin experts.

With over 15 years of experience in aesthetics, Dr. Geetika has built a reputation for personalised care and delivering results with minimal risk. Her clientele includes celebrities, influencers, and discerning individuals who trust her expertise.

She is a pioneer in introducing globally advanced treatments to India — from AI-integrated diagnostics and cutting-edge IV therapy to advanced body sculpting technology — setting new benchmarks in luxury dermatology.

Qualifications

MBBS from Govt. Medical College, Patiala. Post-graduation in Aesthetic Medicine from Cardiff University, UK. Diploma in Aesthetic Medicine from the American Academy of Aesthetic Medicine.

Global Expertise

Attended numerous international workshops and conferences globally. Known for blending ancient and modern scientific techniques to deliver trusted, clinically tested treatments.

Celebrity Trusted

Preferred aesthetic destination for Bollywood celebrities, fashion icons, social media influencers, and high-profile personalities across India's entertainment and fashion industry.

Three-Tier Philosophy

Unique AI-driven approach to long-term beauty built on three pillars: Treatment, Prevention, and Maintenance — ensuring lasting results and healthier skin over time.
